blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — YawYan ArDigma’s decorated Cebuano striker Renan “Flash” Noblefranca gets another chance to showcase his striking skills when he takes on fellow 53-kilogram fighter Rex Villagracia in a semi-professional Muay Thai flyweight bout on Sunday, November 29, at Tiger Muay Thai Bohol’s “Beatdown 4” in Panglao, Bohol. Both Noblefranca and Villagracia tipped the scales at exactly 53 kilograms during the official weigh-in on Saturday, setting the stage for their showdown at the Tiger Muay Thai Bohol Gym. Noblefranca is fresh off a dominant three-round victory over fellow Muay Thai fighter Jhan Villegas in the main event of Yaw-Yan Ardigma’s […]...
